unit_cn: Unit 1 Food for Thought 饮食的学问
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 1 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、饮食/餐桌主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: A balanced diet should include fresh fruit and vegetables.
words.example_cn: 均衡的饮食应该包含新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

words.example_en: When you travel, you should try the local cuisine.
words.example_cn: 旅行时,你应该尝尝当地的菜肴。

words.example_en: My grandmother taught me a simple recipe for chicken soup.
words.example_cn: 我祖母教了我一个简单的鸡汤食谱。

words.example_en: The chef in this restaurant cooks wonderful Sichuan dishes.
words.example_cn: 这家餐馆的厨师做的川菜非常美味。

words.example_en: The waiter recommended the fish, and it was delicious.
words.example_cn: 服务员推荐了这道鱼,味道很好。

words.example_en: An apple makes a healthy snack between meals.
words.example_cn: 一个苹果是两餐之间健康的零食。

words.example_en: We had a warm rice pudding for dessert after dinner.
words.example_cn: 晚饭后我们吃了一份热乎乎的米布丁作甜点。

words.example_en: He ordered a tender steak with a side of vegetables.
words.example_cn: 他点了一份嫩牛排,还配了一份蔬菜。

words.example_en: Nothing beats my mother's homemade sausage at breakfast.
words.example_cn: 早餐时,没什么比得上我妈妈自制的香肠。

words.example_en: A full English breakfast usually has fried bacon and eggs.
words.example_cn: 一份全套英式早餐通常有煎咸肉和鸡蛋。

words.example_en: I like to eat toast with butter and honey in the morning.
words.example_cn: 早上我喜欢吃涂了黄油和蜂蜜的烤面包片。

words.example_en: She spread some butter on the warm bread.
words.example_cn: 她在热面包上抹了一些黄油。

words.example_en: Blue cheese has a strong smell that you either love or hate.
words.example_cn: 蓝纹奶酪气味很重,你要么爱它,要么恨它。

words.example_en: I was afraid to taste stinky tofu, but it was not so bad.
words.example_cn: 我本来不敢尝臭豆腐,但其实没那么糟。

words.example_en: Add a spoon of honey to make the yoghurt taste sweeter.
words.example_cn: 加一勺蜂蜜,让酸奶尝起来更甜。

words.example_en: She had a bowl of fat-free yoghurt with fresh fruit.
words.example_cn: 她吃了一碗加新鲜水果的脱脂酸奶。

words.example_en: The small bakery on the corner sells fresh bread every morning.
words.example_cn: 街角那家小面包店每天早上都卖新鲜面包。

words.example_en: I went to the butcher's shop to buy some pork for dinner.
words.example_cn: 我去肉店买了些猪肉做晚饭。

words.example_en: In China, people often cook many dishes to honour a guest.
words.example_cn: 在中国,人们常做很多菜来款待客人。

words.example_en: The whole family gathers around the table for a big dinner.
words.example_cn: 全家人围在桌旁享用一顿丰盛的晚餐。

words.example_en: After their marriage, the couple learned to cook each other's favourite food.
words.example_cn: 婚后,这对夫妻学会了做对方最爱吃的菜。

words.example_en: At the wedding dinner, the guests were served eight special dishes.
words.example_cn: 在婚宴上,客人们享用了八道特别的菜肴。

words.example_en: Eating dumplings at New Year is an old custom in the north.
words.example_cn: 新年吃饺子是北方一个古老的风俗。

words.example_en: Good table manners mean you wait until everyone is served.
words.example_cn: 良好的餐桌礼仪意味着你要等大家都上了菜再动筷。

words.example_en: When you finish, place the knife and fork together on your plate.
words.example_cn: 吃完后,把刀叉并排放在盘子上。

words.example_en: Here are some useful tips for good table manners.
words.example_cn: 这里有一些关于餐桌礼仪的实用建议。

words.example_en: The trick is to start with the knife and fork on the outside.
words.example_cn: 诀窍是从最外侧的那副刀叉开始用。

words.example_en: In my opinion, this is the best noodle shop in town.
words.example_cn: 在我看来,这是城里最好的面馆。

words.example_en: My father does not enjoy this sort of strong-smelling food.
words.example_cn: 我父亲不喜欢这种气味很重的食物。

words.example_en: A typical Sunday roast includes beef and roast vegetables.
words.example_cn: 一顿典型的周日烤肉餐有牛肉和烤蔬菜。

words.meaning_cn: 烤制的;烤好的;(n.)大块烤肉
words.example_en: We all love roast beef with potatoes on a cold day.
words.example_cn: 天冷时我们都爱吃配土豆的烤牛肉。

words.meaning_cn: 嫩的;软的(烹饪恰到好处)
words.example_en: The meat was so tender that it melted in the mouth.
words.example_cn: 这肉非常嫩,入口即化。

words.example_en: The sauce had a slightly bitter taste that I did not enjoy.
words.example_cn: 这酱汁有一点苦味,我不太喜欢。

words.example_en: This dish combines sweet and sour flavours in a clever way.
words.example_cn: 这道菜巧妙地把甜味和酸味结合在一起。

words.example_en: The soup was too salty, so I added a little water.
words.example_cn: 这汤太咸了,我加了点水。

words.example_en: The cheesecake was smooth and creamy with fresh strawberries.
words.example_cn: 这块芝士蛋糕软滑细腻,还有新鲜草莓。

words.example_en: The meatball was cooked through but looked slightly pink inside.
words.example_cn: 这肉丸熟透了,但里面看起来略带粉色。

words.example_en: At first the dish gave off a horrible smell, like an old shoe.
words.example_cn: 起初这道菜散发出一股可怕的气味,像只旧鞋子。

words.meaning_cn: 令人满意的;令人满足的
words.example_en: After a long day, a warm and satisfying meal is just perfect.
words.example_cn: 忙碌了一天后,一顿温暖又满足的饭菜再好不过了。

words.example_en: Ready meals are convenient, but fresh food is healthier.
words.example_cn: 速食方便,但新鲜食物更健康。

words.example_en: Mum says we may suffer from too much heat if we eat lots of roast food.
words.example_cn: 妈妈说,如果吃太多烤制食物,我们可能会上火。

words.example_en: The smell of fresh bread is really hard to resist.
words.example_cn: 新鲜面包的香味实在让人难以抗拒。

words.example_en: This recipe is easy to adapt to your own taste.
words.example_cn: 这个食谱很容易根据你自己的口味来调整。

words.example_en: The sugar in soft drinks can attack the teeth for about twenty minutes.
words.example_cn: 软饮料里的糖会侵蚀牙齿大约二十分钟。

words.example_en: Can you guess which fridge belongs to which person?
words.example_cn: 你能猜出哪个冰箱属于哪个人吗?

words.example_en: You can download this app to help you choose healthy food.
words.example_cn: 你可以下载这个应用,帮你挑选健康食物。

words.example_en: If you are a sugar addict, it is hard to say no to chocolate.
words.example_cn: 如果你嗜糖如命,就很难拒绝巧克力。

words.example_en: People say that one man's meat is another man's poison.
words.example_cn: 人们说,甲之美食,乙之毒药。

words.meaning_cn: 功能;作用;盛大的社交活动
words.example_en: The main function of breakfast is to give you energy for the day.
words.example_cn: 早餐的主要功能是为你一天提供能量。

words.example_en: Table manners differ from one country to another.
words.example_cn: 餐桌礼仪因国家不同而有所差异。
